assertions.name: SDP shadow price predicts temperatures far above empirical

description: Rigorous SDP derivation of molecular boiling and melting points. Replaces the fitted h² parameter with the canonical LP-dual shadow price of the H_2(q) Wedderburn idempotents. The SDP selects the antisymmetric e_− (directional H-bond) channel, producing a shadow price y0* ≈ 0.3036. Plugging this derived cohesion into the bare q-ideal gas equation yields temperatures of order ~10^4 K, proving that a purely structural map from P_q V_q = n_q R T requires a much larger entropic/topological denominator ΔS_vap than simply [2]_q.
